## 3. Troubleshooting performed, and the limits of support access

No new testing on this tenant since my Sep 21 note. The precedent and the open points listed there still stand.

Conversations outside this ticket: one customer email. Chris Angelica sent it to all Claire's data partners on Sep 24 at 10:44 ET, and Shreyas Amai attached it to this ticket the same day. direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-24-rcs-29037-shreyas
direct_evidence.body:
Hi @Shreyas Amai, thanks for sharing Chris's update.

This widens the scope from what we had on Sep 21. It is no longer a VPN issue only. All of Claire's external integrations have been offline since Saturday Sep 19, with no ETA, so the gap on c439_rawdata_postransactions already covers six trading days and keeps growing.

Chris says he will reach out individually to arrange how data resumes. When he does, could we ask him one thing? Whether their systems are holding the POS transactions from the outage period, and whether they can resend them with the original trading day on each record. That answer decides if resumed transmission alone can cover the gap.

On our side the open question for Engineering stays the same. Whether trading days that stay under the Work Item volume threshold during the outage get picked up once the late data arrives, or stay skipped. I would hold any recovery instructions to Claire's until that is confirmed.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-21-rcs-29037-teams-sanath
direct_evidence.body:
Hi Sanath, thanks for flagging this. I identified that Claire's ingests via API, endpoint c439_rawdata_postransactions, which is a Gateway file source. Per SLA Rules 9.5 that type routes to Engineering with product type RTIaaS, so I am moving RCS-29037 there instead of answering it from Support.

There is a precedent on file, RCS-28170, TJX, same feed type. The client's API keys expired, the feed stopped, and one trading day landed under the Work Item volume threshold. Once the client resumed sending, that volume recovered on its own with no separate historical file involved. That points to resuming transmission being enough for Claire's too.

One point still needs Engineering to confirm before we can tell the customer for certain. Whether a trading day that fell under the threshold during the outage gets picked up if the missing data arrives late, or stays skipped. I am sending that to Engineering now and will update the ticket once I hear back.
